intent: To illustrate the increasing proportion of voters residing in landslide counties from 1976 to 2016.

requirements.question: Must the video explicitly convey monotonic increase across all three years?
Is the 1976 starting relative value required as a specific starting endpoint?
Is the 2016 ending relative value required as a specific ending endpoint?
Must the video quantify the total 1976-to-2016 increase, or is direction alone enough?

units.claim: The relative value is higher in each later year than in the previous year, establishing an increasing trend/order: 1976 < 2012 < 2016.

basis.note: lowest value in the ordered series
middle value in the ordered series
highest value in the ordered series

accept: The relative share rises in each successive year
Later years have higher relative values than earlier years
1976 is lowest, 2012 is middle, 2016 is highest
The proportion increases from 1976 to 2012 to 2016
units.evidence: A viewer must be able to compare the three relative values and see the monotonic increase.

units.claim: The starting endpoint in 1976 has relative value 0.2787.
accept: 1976 begins at a relative value of 0.2787
units.evidence: The 1976 data point's relative value must be visible or readable as 0.2787.

units.claim: The ending endpoint in 2016 has relative value 0.5972.
accept: 2016 ends at a relative value of 0.5972
units.evidence: The 2016 data point's relative value must be visible or readable as 0.5972.

units.claim: The total 1976-to-2016 increase is 0.3185 in relative value, and the 2016 relative value is about 2.14 times the 1976 relative value.
accept: The relative value increases by 0.3185 from 1976 to 2016
2016 relative value is about 2.14 times the 1976 relative value
The 1976-to-2016 rise is 0.5972 minus 0.2787 = 0.3185 relative units
The endpoint relative share is more than double the starting relative share
units.evidence: The visual must allow seeing the magnitude of the 1976-to-2016 increase, not just its direction.

optional_valid: The 2012 relative_value 0.4976 lies between the 1976 and 2016 values.
The 2012 relative_value 0.4976 is closer to the 2016 value than to the 1976 value: differences are 0.0996 versus 0.2189.
The 2012 relative_value 0.4976 is above the midpoint of the 1976 and 2016 endpoints: midpoint 0.43795.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
